Basics

Egg spread

Tojáskrém

6 months+ Sound idea 15 min 1 portion

From 6 months. If egg or milk is new, try the first taste in the morning on a well day. Once tolerated, keep offering egg and milk a few times a week.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1 egg (hard-boiled for 10 minutes)
  • 2 tbsp plain pasteurized yogurt (unsweetened)

Allergens

milkegg

Method

  1. Boil the egg for 10 minutes so the yolk is firm.
  2. Cool it in cold water and peel it.
  3. Mash the whole egg with the yogurt.
  4. Thin until it spoons easily.
  5. Serve fresh, with no raw yolk and no mayonnaise.

Sound idea

Raw yolk mayonnaise is undercooked egg in a salty sauce.

Mash a hard-boiled egg with yogurt and skip any raw egg.
